Config_Token_Desc: Optional. Leave empty to let the plugin fetch and cache a token automatically.
Config_TranslationLanguage_Desc: ISO language code for line translations fetched from Musixmatch (e.g. pt, en, es). Use 'none' to disable.
Config_PreferWordByWord_Desc: When available, use Musixmatch's word-by-word timing instead of line-only synced lyrics.
